messages:
emily-ps: FYI multiple customers are reporting 5xx/timeouts from the hosted API starting ~04:23 UTC. Symptoms: p95/p99 latency spike, gateway 502/504, and a bunch of early_rejects tied to request queue depth.
jamie-sre: Can you paste a couple correlation ids and the tenant(s) affected? Any recent continuous-batcher rollout or config change?
mike-b: Also useful — are retries coming from SDKs? Retry storms amplify queues.
emily-ps: Tenant example: acme-123. Sample correlation ids: req=0a1b2c3d, req=7f8e9d0c. Relevant sample logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T04:23:12Z] WARN gateway: request_queue_depth=820 continuous_batcher_backlog_ms=320 req_id=0a1b2c3d model=rwd-3-large status=early_reject
[2026-03-17T04:24:05Z] ERROR handler: dequeue_timeout after=2500ms tenant=acme-123 route=hosted-gw req_id=7f8e9d0c
```
Also seeing many 504s from batcher-dequeue with dequeuer_wait>2s.
laura-ng: Quick mitigation idea: temporarily route acme-123 to rwd-compact-1 and increase batcher-controller replicas for the affected pool. That reduces per-request decode cost. @jamie-sre can you action? :thumbsup: 
jamie-sre: Scaling batcher-controller replicas on prod-cluster-5 +3 now. Also lowering continuous_batcher_max_wait_ms 50->20ms for the model-group to reduce batching tail latency. Command run: 
```
kubectl patch deployment batcher-controller -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":12}}'
```
support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0423: request-queue-slowlane-exceeded -> paging oncall.
ops-bot: Alert: gateway/hosted/request_queue_depth >= 800 on prod-cluster-5 (04:23 UTC) -> escalation trigger.
mike-b: Observed pattern: huge number of small seq requests (avg len 8 tokens) with cross-tenant fanout causing batcher packing and KV cache pressure. Recommend temporarily lowering batch_size_soft_limit and enabling immediate passthrough (non-batched) for tiny sequences to avoid long queue waits.
emily-ps: Customers are also retrying aggressively (default SDK backoff), which is amplifying the surge. Some tenants also sent larger prompts unexpectedly, increasing decode times. Not all traffic concentrated to one tenant.
jamie-sre: Telemetry: acme-123 accounts for ~28% of spike, rest is distributed. I'm applying a temporary tenant-qos: max_inflight_per_tenant=50 for hosted-gw and enabling fallthrough route to non-batched execution when queue_depth>700. Patch applied. Monitoring metrics now.
laura-ng: Action items: (1) jamie — capture full trace dumps + correlation ids for top 10 5xx (2) emily — notify affected CSMs and collect customer repros (3) mike — suggest SDK retry/backoff guidance and patch examples. If not resolved in 24h we'll open a full postmortem. Monitor for 30m and update thread.
emily-ps: Thanks — I'll update CSMs and attach any repro requests. :white_check_mark:
